bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.OrderingKey.sc.description:
OrderingKey is the key every write is compared by, left to right:
 (observed_at, observation_id, event_id, content_hash)
 (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Ordering and idempotency"). The strings compare
 by their UTF-8 bytes; pkg/model compares keys.

^(contentHash)$.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of the observation's data; for a
 manual event, of the payload.

^(eventId)$.description: The event that carried it, which includes the source.

^(observationId)$.description: The observation that made the write; for a manual event, the event ID.
